notes: 5 us/message is a configurable CPU submission assumption, charged once on the source worker host resource, not on the link.
25 GB/s is the previous theoretical bandwidth assumption, not measured NVLink bandwidth. No additional device startup latency is assumed yet.
0 us completion means event-driven completion without extra callback service; it does not eliminate dependency or queue waiting.
CPU and link queues are generated by the scheduler. Do not insert measured queue/idle gaps into either fixed cost.
per_worker represents independent communication submission workers; shared represents one host submission thread for all endpoints.
Compute operator tables remain eager measurements and can include host gaps; this change only separates communication timing.
